title: Read the Rate Graph
premise: On the graph of a proportional relationship, two points are special: (0, 0) and (1, r). The r is the unit rate.
idea: Explaining what a point (x, y) on the graph of a proportional relationship means, with special attention to (0, 0) and (1, r). Not being able to interpret points in context is the known slip.
author: claude-stand-in
